image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: educational salon assessment image for a mobile hair-aesthetics training case
Primary request: Create one horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the SAME fictional adult East Asian woman in her CURRENT hairstyle only: front view, true right profile, true left profile, and back view. This is not a makeover or a proposed design.
Scene/backdrop: neutral warm-gray salon studio backdrop, no branding, furniture, tools, or props.
Subject: one fictional adult woman with consistent identity, face proportions, skin tone, clothing, hair color, and exact hairstyle across all four panels. Current hair is a dark natural-brown grown-out short layered bixie: top surface mostly straight and relatively flat, no artificial root lift; the maximum width and weight collect around the lower temple, ear, and jaw areas; the side lengths reach just below the jaw, the back shows a comparatively quiet upper occipital area and a soft grown-out nape ending above the shoulders. Medium-to-coarse-looking strands with ordinary natural shine, but no diagnosis of density or damage. Hair worn down in every panel. Calm neutral expression in the front panel. Simple matte black wide-neck top, clearly showing full neck and both moderately broad shoulders.
Style/medium: highly realistic neutral salon documentation photography, real skin pores and individual hair fibers, no beauty filter, no glamour retouching.
Composition/framing: four equal vertical panels in one landscape image; each panel shows the complete head, crown, hairstyle baseline, neck, both shoulders, and upper chest. Same camera height, focal length, distance, scale, and lighting. Front must be truly frontal; side panels true 90-degree profiles; back directly from behind. No cropping of crown, nape, neck, or shoulders.
Lighting/mood: soft even neutral daylight with enough separation to read crown height, side width, occipital contour, nape, neck, and shoulder relationship.
Constraints: current-state documentation only; same person and exact current hairstyle in all panels; no helmet in the image, no proposed high crown, no perm, no after photo, no cutting guides, no labels, no text, no watermark.
Avoid: split identities, three-quarter side views, mirrored duplicate side views, beautification, exaggerated skull shape, wet hair, curls, accessories, hands, tools, logos, measurements, before/after claims.
